## Data source

Which API or provider would back this? cosmo-travel-mcp only uses licensed
commercial providers (currently SerpAPI and Google Maps Routes). If you
have a specific endpoint in mind, link to its docs.

## Why not a separate server?

This project is deliberately scoped — it bundles travel-planning tools, not
every API under the sun. If your request is better served by a standalone
MCP server (e.g. general Google Maps, weather, currency conversion), say so
here so we can decide whether to recommend that instead.
